docs.title: BRIDGE Central Schema
docs.text:
The central BRIDGE schema for harmonized cross-BER data access. Composes the shared base elements in core.yaml with domain modules (currently: measurements.yaml and the draft umbrella.yaml).

URI: https://w3id.org/ber-data/bridge-central-schema

Name: ber-central-schema

docs.title: Class: Sample
docs.text: A physical material that can be characterized by an experiment.

docs.title: Induced
docs.text:
name: Sample
description: A physical material that can be characterized by an experiment.
comments:
- 'Concrete sample types stay in the source schemas: nmdc:Biosample and nmdc:OrganismSample,
  and the 18 direct BASALT Sample subclasses (SoilSample, WaterSample, ...).'
- BASALT records collection on a separate SamplingActivity class; NMDC records it
  on the sample. This draft leaves the sampling event out.
- There is no separate class for processed samples. A sample produced by a processing
  step is a Sample, and sample_category says what kind of sample it is.
from_schema: https://w3id.org/ber-data/bridge-central-schema

    rank: 1000

docs.title: ber-central-schema
docs.text:
The central BRIDGE schema for harmonized cross-BER data access. Composes the shared base elements in core.yaml with domain modules (currently: measurements.yaml and the draft umbrella.yaml).

URI: https://w3id.org/ber-data/bridge-central-schema

docs.title: Slot: collected_at
docs.text: The site the sample was collected from.

docs.title: Slot: description
docs.text: A human-readable description for a thing

docs.title: Slot: external_identifiers
docs.text: Identifiers for the same entity in the system that holds the original record, such as GOLD, EMSL or INSDC. Lets a record that one BER system redistributes from another be matched to the original.

docs.title: Slot: has_input
docs.text: The things a process takes in, such as samples or data.

docs.title: Slot: has_output
docs.text: The things a process produces, such as samples or data.

docs.title: Slot: id
docs.text: A unique identifier for a thing

docs.title: Slot: name
docs.text: A human-readable name for a thing

docs.title: Slot: observed_property
docs.text: The property observed; a BERVO Variable CURIE when one exists.

docs.title: Slot: organism
docs.text: The organism the sample is expected to contain, when it is one organism.

docs.title: Slot: processing
docs.text: The processing step this link row belongs to.

docs.title: Slot: protocol
docs.text: A link to the protocol the step followed.

docs.title: Slot: raw_value
docs.text: The value exactly as it appeared at the source.

docs.title: Slot: result
docs.text: The result of the observation.

docs.title: Slot: role
docs.text: Whether the sample went into or came out of the processing step.

docs.title: Slot: sample
docs.text: The sample this link row connects to the processing step.

docs.title: Slot: sample_category
docs.text: Where the sample's material came from, such as a pure culture, an engineered strain or the environment. Programs and protocols (MONet, Terraform, AMP2) stay with the study and the source schema.

docs.title: Slot: taxon
docs.text: Taxonomic classification, as an NCBITaxon CURIE.

docs.title: Slot: unit
docs.text: UCUM code preferred.
